article.story: AMHERST, Mass. -- — Eric Chatfield Jr. scored 30 points, six in the overtime, as Bryant beat UMass 83-79 on Tuesday. Chatfield went 10 of 21 from the field (8 for 15 from 3-point range) for the Bulldogs (2-4). Ty Tabales scored 15 points and Duane Thompson pitched in with 14 points and eight rebounds. Dwayne Wimbley Jr. finished with 18 points, 12 rebounds and two steals for the Minutemen (2-2). Danny Carbuccia added 17 points and six assists, while Junjie Wang totaled 13 points. Tabales scored six points in the first half and Bryant went into the break trailing 28-21. Up next: Bryant's next game is Friday against Worcester State at home. UMass hosts Maine on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
